messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Runtime canary failure detected - elevated latency + kernel fallback after deploy to prod-us-west. Canary health 5/10. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/runtimes/canary

 deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/serve-v3 @ 1768469950

 oncall-alex: paging oncall. taking it.

 eng-maya: looking — seeing kernel fallback spikes on batcher nodes, microbatch queue depths rising. correlates with deploy/serve-v3.

 oncall-alex: quick ask: any feature flags toggled with this rollout?

 platform-lead-sam: yep, feature flag `batch-v2` enabled in canary subset during rollout.

 oncall-alex: can we flip it off for canaries? trying to isolate.

 platform-lead-sam: running: /ff toggle batch-v2 canary off
 platform-lead-sam: ✅ flag flipped, targeting canary pool

 incident-bot: Action logged - flag change by platform-lead-sam

 eng-maya: after flip fallback rate down ~30% but latency still >target. batch queue depth stays high. suspect kernel selection regress.

 oncall-alex: preparing rollback for canary kernel selection. eng-maya, you ok to run kill-switch? I'll notify CS.

 eng-maya: initiating rollback: rollback_id=rb-1768470001 -> revert kernel selection to v2

 deployment-bot: Rollback started for release/serve-v3 canary -> previous kernel profile (rb-1768470001)

 prod-support-liam: CS: we have 3 customers reporting slow responses (increased tail latency), no errors. Escalated to priority support, keeping them updated.

 oncall-alex: good. leaving handoff notes: rollback in progress, flag off, monitoring dashboards. Handoff to night oncall at 02:00 UTC.

 eng-oncall-night: received handoff, will monitor p50/p95/p99 and eviction/fallback rates for 2hr window. Ping if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

 oncall-alex: thanks team. adding runbook link and next steps in incident ticket.

 incident-bot: Incident closed for active paging; continuing monitoring in background. If regressions reappear, re-open and escalate.
